complete_examples.text: In order to construct the evolution model, the following three assumptions are made: (1) The profile irregularity’s evolution is only related to the tonnage of passage T and the dynamic load Fdyn; (2) Due to the complexity and randomness of the evolutionary law of track profile irregularities, the uncertainty of track degradation is taken into consideration.
The tonnage of passage T at the measurement period can be approximately estimated by referring to the train operation schedule [14].
